messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: inference-runtime-us-west2 - 5xx spike + KV cache hit-rate drop. 503 rate > 4% over 5m, kv_cache.hit_rate < 28% for 5m. Paging oncall.
alice: ack — I'm on it, joining call now. pulling links.
alice: looks like a sudden jump in evictions, small LRU churn. dashboards show backend latency up ~150ms.
bob: paging in — any customer-facing alerts?
alice: some customer retries surfaced in SLO logs, small UX impact on streaming endpoints. CS flagged two customers.
charlie: oncall handoff in 25m approx?
alice: yes, planning to hand off once mitigations are stable.
alice: quick mitigation: bumped kv cache max_entries from 200k -> 320k for us-west2 pool, restarted cache service on 3 hosts (rolling).
bob: noted. did you change eviction policy?
alice: not yet. I want to avoid full restart. temporary: increased memory cap and widened window for eviction to reduce thrash.
deploy-bot: deploy 7f3a2d to infra-cache/us-west2 succeeded (canary 1/3).
alice: canary looks good, hit-rate recovered from 26% -> 61% over 6m on canary host.
bob: good signal. I'm going to mute the noisy kv hit-rate alert while we adjust thresholds so we don't page again.
charlie: please add a ticket and post the alert change in #eng-sre afterward. we need to avoid muting permanently.
alice: creating ticket now: INF-4219. summary: transient cache thrash due to small working set + eviction punting after a bad ingestion spike. action items in ticket.
devex: add a synthetic job that warms KV prefixes for streaming routes during deploys? would help.
bob: +1. also suggest changing alert to 10m window and require sustained low hit-rate + 5xx spike. current pairing of <30% over 5m was too sensitive.
alice: proposed new alert rule (will apply to us-west2 only):

```
alert: KVCacheLowHitRateSustained
expr: (sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[10m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests[10m]))) < 0.40 and increase(rate(inference_5xx[10m])) > 0.02
for: 10m
labels: { severity="P2", team="runtime" }
annotations: { runbook="link-to-runbook", note="paired with 5xx increase to reduce noise" }
```

alice: I'll push rule to staging and run replay.
bob: also add a squelch period for noisy hours after deploys: 30m suppress if there was a cache config update.
charlie: capture that in the runbook. include specific dashboard panels to check: per-pool hit-rate, eviction-rate, miss token rate, tail latency per model.
devex: I'm adding a new dashboard tile for rolling-median hit-rate (10m) and a heatmap of eviction_count by host. will share link.
alice: handoff note for next oncall (charlie): mitigation done — increased cap, canary healthy, new alert rule staged, ticket INF-4219 tracking followups. please watch for regressions for next 2hrs.
charlie: taking over. leaving page window open. will escalate if hit-rate drops below 35% for 15m or 5xx > 3%.
bob: post-incident follow-ups: 1) tune alert to use paired 5xx guard, 2) make synthetic warmers, 3) add eviction anomaly alert (evictions/sec spike > x), 4) add dashboard panel for prefix-level heatmap.
charlie: agree. also recommend a short retro with infra and models teams to understand the ingestion pattern that caused thrash.
alice: thanks team. closing pager. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: inference-runtime-us-west2 — root cause suspected cache thrash from burst ingestion, mitigations applied, followups filed (INF-4219).
charlie: leaving final note in ticket: classify as "operational - threshold tuning" and schedule a 1hr tuning session next week.
bob: I'll do the alert PR after lunch and link the dashboard.
devex: dashboard draft: https://grafana.example.com/d/abcd/kv-cache — will post in #eng-sre when live.
charlie: handing to next rotation. thanks all.
